title: Charity FIFA Tournament
summary: An individual FIFA competition on PS5 — with certificates for everyone, a coffee break with baked goods and funds raised for a good cause.
description:
Every autumn we swap the court for the console. Our FIFA tournament is an individual competition on PS5, open to anyone who wants to take part.

Every participant receives a certificate, and there is a coffee break with baked goods between matches.
impact: November 9, 2025: funds supported the Kaynar centre, which helps stray animals.
